I finished Standard 8 so I can read the labels on the bags, but I learned rice farming from my father in this same dambo. This plot is only 0.16 hectares, so I will take one-third of a 50kg NPK bag that I am sharing with my uncle and cousin — that is enough for this small land without wasting cash. I will also carry manure from our livestock pen because this land belongs to us, and I will plant the local rice seed I saved from last year. My brother and I will do all the transplanting and weeding ourselves, about twenty-five family labor days in total, and we will not hire anyone or use chemicals.
